company_schedule_day_hours_valid.name: company_schedule_day_hours_valid
company_schedule_day_hours_valid.value: ("company_schedule_day"."start_time" is null and "company_schedule_day"."end_time" is null) or ("company_schedule_day"."start_time" is not null and "company_schedule_day"."end_time" is not null and "company_schedule_day"."start_time" < "company_schedule_day"."end_time" and extract(second from "company_schedule_day"."start_time") = 0 and extract(second from "company_schedule_day"."end_time") = 0 and "company_schedule_day"."end_time" < time '24:00:00')

attendance_review_values_valid.name: attendance_review_values_valid
attendance_review_values_valid.value: "attendance_session"."revision" >= 0 and "attendance_session"."approved_outside_seconds" >= 0 and ("attendance_session"."review_state" = 'approved' or "attendance_session"."approved_outside_seconds" = 0) and "attendance_session"."max_open_hours" between 8 and 72

job_coordinates_valid.name: job_coordinates_valid
job_coordinates_valid.value: ("job"."longitude" is null and "job"."latitude" is null) or ("job"."longitude" is not null and "job"."latitude" is not null and "job"."longitude" between -180 and 180 and "job"."latitude" between -85 and 85)

job_text_valid.name: job_text_valid
job_text_valid.value: char_length(trim("job"."title")) between 3 and 160 and char_length("job"."notes") <= 4000 and char_length("job"."address") <= 300

job_deadline_valid.name: job_deadline_valid
job_deadline_valid.value: "job"."deadline" is null or "job"."deadline" between date '1900-01-01' and date '2100-12-31'

job_location_labels_valid.name: job_location_labels_valid
job_location_labels_valid.value: char_length("job"."street_name_ka") <= 300 and char_length("job"."street_name_en") <= 300 and char_length("job"."location_label_ka") <= 300 and char_length("job"."location_label_en") <= 300

job_assignment_valid.name: job_assignment_valid
job_assignment_valid.value: ("job"."status" = 'pending' and "job"."assignee_id" is null) or ("job"."status" in ('en_route', 'on_site', 'completed') and "job"."assignee_id" is not null) or "job"."status" = 'rejected'

job_event_note_valid.name: job_event_note_valid
job_event_note_valid.value: char_length("job_event"."note") <= 2000 and ("job_event"."action" <> 'status_changed' or "job_event"."status" not in ('rejected', 'pending') or char_length(trim("job_event"."note")) >= 5)

leave_request_dates_valid.name: leave_request_dates_valid
leave_request_dates_valid.value: ("leave_request"."kind" = 'sick_leave' and ("leave_request"."end_date" is null or "leave_request"."end_date" >= "leave_request"."start_date")) or ("leave_request"."kind" <> 'sick_leave' and "leave_request"."end_date" is not null and "leave_request"."end_date" >= "leave_request"."start_date" and "leave_request"."end_date" - "leave_request"."start_date" <= 365)

leave_request_review_valid.name: leave_request_review_valid
leave_request_review_valid.value: ("leave_request"."reviewer_id" is null and "leave_request"."reviewed_at" is null and "leave_request"."review_reason" = '' and "leave_request"."status" in ('pending', 'cancelled')) or ("leave_request"."reviewer_id" is not null and "leave_request"."reviewer_id" <> "leave_request"."requester_id" and "leave_request"."reviewed_at" is not null and "leave_request"."status" <> 'cancelled' and length("leave_request"."review_reason") <= 500)

vacation_period_year.name: vacation_period_year
vacation_period_year.default: extract(year from now() at time zone 'Asia/Tbilisi')::int

day_off_balance_valid.name: day_off_balance_valid
day_off_balance_valid.value: "day_off_balance"."annual_days" between 0 and 366 and "day_off_balance"."remaining_days" between 0 and 3660 and "day_off_balance"."period_year" between 2000 and 2100 and "day_off_balance"."revision" >= 0 and "day_off_balance"."vacation_annual_days" between 24 and 366 and "day_off_balance"."vacation_remaining_days" between 0 and 100000 and "day_off_balance"."vacation_period_year" between 2000 and 2100

day_off_setting_valid.name: day_off_setting_valid
day_off_setting_valid.value: "day_off_setting"."id" = 1 and "day_off_setting"."default_days" between 0 and 366 and "day_off_setting"."revision" >= 0 and "day_off_setting"."default_vacation_days" between 24 and 366
